name: mergehub-requirement-workflow
description: Operate MergeHub requirement tasks from Codex with requirement document lookup, plan approval gates, self-test completion, and structured daily work records.

interface.shortDescription: Pull tasks and requirement docs, upload plans, gate development, sync self-tests, and record work.
interface.longDescription: MergeHub Requirement Workflow connects Codex to MergeHub's requirement delivery loop: pull assigned requirement tasks, fetch the linked requirement description and document URL before planning, upload implementation plans, verify the latest plan is approved before creating development runs, require explicit user confirmation before direct development on an unapproved plan, sync progress, record commits and complete artifact contents with Markdown for human-readable documents and native formats for machine-applied files, submit developer self-tests, mark development tasks done after passed self-test, and keep structured Codex work records for MergeHub daily reports and SP evaluation.
defaultPrompt: Pull my MergeHub requirement tasks and docs.
Upload an implementation plan for this requirement.
Submit a passed self-test and mark this development task done.
